args.title: Fix CSV export to handle transactions with different currencies
args.body: Issue 4206 reports that when two transactions have the same date, amount, and description but different currencies (one EUR, one USD), only one of them is included in the exported CSV file. It appears that the CSV writer in `src/export/csv.ts` is merging these identical transactions due to their shared attributes. This pull request aims to address the CSV export functionality to ensure transactions with different currencies are correctly exported without merging them, thereby improving the accuracy of the exported data. The changes will ensure that both transactions appear in the resulting CSV.
